metadata.description: Nerd4Rent open-source Claude Code skills for daily developer workflows.

plugins.name: nerd4rent
plugins.description: Daily developer workflow automation — bootstrap new projects with git, GitHub, Linear, and spec-creating skills; write well-specified Linear issues; drive Linear issues through a status-driven plan-implement-review workflow; mechanically close out an issue (commit, push, merge PR/MR on GitHub or GitLab, set Done); bootstrap the CLIs those skills require; and manage a personal agent-skills manifest across Claude Code, Cursor, and other coding agents.
